summary: The ML test suite now covers stopping text generation, choosing a device for a model, and running llama.cpp on macOS’s Metal GPU. It also adds checks for ONNX model memory use and cleanup after startup failures, model downloads using the Origin Private File System (OPFS), and Smart Window’s handling of exhausted service budgets; some tests that pass under ThreadSanitizer (a tool for finding concurrency problems) were re-enabled.
